```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(class)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
load("SKCM.rda")
combat_expr <- assay(query2)
```

```{r}
short_id <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(combat_expr), "-"), function(x) paste(x[1:3], collapse = "-"))

```

```{r}
survival_q1 <- quantile(clinical$survival_time, probs = 1/3, na.rm = TRUE)
survival_q2 <- quantile(clinical$survival_time, probs = 2/3, na.rm = TRUE)

survival_group <- cut(
  clinical$survival_time,
  breaks = c(-Inf, survival_q1, survival_q2, Inf),
  labels = c("Low", "Medium", "High")
)

group <- survival_group[match(short_id, clinical$patient)]
table(group, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
keep_samples <- !is.na(group)

X <- t(combat_expr[, keep_samples])
y <- group[keep_samples]
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
train_idx <- sample(1:nrow(X), size = 0.7 * nrow(X))

X_train <- X[train_idx, ]
X_test <- X[-train_idx, ]

y_train <- y[train_idx]
y_test <- y[-train_idx]
```

```{r}
library(caret)

train_control <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 5)

k_grid <- expand.grid(k = seq(3, 15, by = 2))

set.seed(123)
knn_model <- train(
  x = X_train,
  y = y_train,
  method = "knn",
  tuneGrid = k_grid,
  trControl = train_control
)

print(knn_model)
```

```{r}
knn_pred <- predict(knn_model, newdata = X_test)

accuracy <- mean(knn_pred == y_test)
print(paste("KNN accuracy:", round(accuracy, 3)))

cm <- confusionMatrix(knn_pred, y_test)
print(cm)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

cm_table <- as.data.frame(cm$table)

ggplot(cm_table, aes(x = Reference, y = Prediction, fill = Freq)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = Freq), color = "white", size = 6) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "blue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Confusion Matrix (KNN 3-bin Survival, caret tuned)", x = "True Label", y = "Predicted Label")

```
